This is a fictional posting for the Jobweaver demo. Maintain reproducible climate data tools for a small research team.

Python for scientific data processing is required. You must investigate corrupted climate-model output. Experience preparing NetCDF datasets is required. A released Python package is a plus. English is the working language. German is not required.
